details:
* SECURITY UPDATE: unbounded hash-chain walk in the delta-transfer matcher
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-70453.patch: bound the hash_search() chain walk
       in match.c so a crafted checksum set cannot drive quadratic CPU use
     - CVE-2026-70453
   * SECURITY UPDATE: peer-supplied I/O timeout accepted as non-positive
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-70462.patch: reject a non-positive
       MSG_IO_TIMEOUT from the peer in io.c
     - CVE-2026-70462
   * SECURITY UPDATE: unbounded daemon pre-transfer handshake
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-70464.patch: bound the pre-transfer handshake
       with a timeout in clientserver.c and io.c
     - CVE-2026-70464
   * SECURITY UPDATE: malicious-peer protocol input and checksum-slot lifetime
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-70458-1.patch: daemon robustness against
       malicious-peer protocol input
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-70458-2.patch: guard the F_SUM checksum-slot
       lifetime in hlink.c and main.c
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-70458-3-copy-devices.patch: extend the same
       guard to the copy-devices path
     - CVE-2026-70458
   * SECURITY UPDATE: daemon authentication, access and argument hardening
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-53790-1.patch: harden daemon authentication,
       access, socket and argument handling
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-53790-2-shell-chars.patch: confine operator- and
       peer-supplied paths to the served tree and reject shell metacharacters
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-53790-3-uninit.patch: fix a safe_arg()
       uninitialized-byte leak in options.c
     - CVE-2026-53790
   * SECURITY UPDATE: inner-module escape for a daemon module using /./
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-53793-1-basis-paths.patch: stat alternate-basis
       candidates through the confined resolver in generator.c
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-53793-2-inner-module.patch: widen the
       use_secure_symlinks and change_dir() gates from "am_daemon &&
       !am_chrooted" to "am_daemon && (!am_chrooted || module_dirlen)" so an
       inner module root is the trust boundary, not the kernel chroot
     - CVE-2026-53793
